name: werewolf-game
description: Real-time multiplayer Werewolf (Ma Soi) game with 3D characters

scripts.devLocal: concurrently -n infra,client,server -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm devLocal:infra" "pnpm --filter client devLocal" "pnpm devLocal:server"
scripts.devLocal:server: wait-on tcp:5432 tcp:6379 && pnpm --filter server dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter client build && pnpm --filter server build
